title: Chebyshev Quotients and Demazure Multiplicities
abstract: Formalizes positivity results for the coefficients of Chebyshev-type polynomial quotients attached to integer partitions, modelling Demazure multiplicities. Proves that the relevant generating function is a polynomial and that its coefficients are eventually positive (Theorem 1), gives explicit Cauchy-product and matrix-inverse formulas for the coefficients (Theorem 2), and establishes their nonnegativity through a Dyck-path lattice counting model (Theorem 3).

informal.Biswal.Theorem1.genFun_is_polynomial: Proves that the generating function attached to a partition is a polynomial whenever its parts are bounded by the parameter `m`.
informal.Biswal.Theorem1.genFun_coeff_eventually_: Proves that the coefficients of the generating function attached to a partition are eventually strictly positive.
informal.Biswal.Theorem23.thm_manifest_coeff_nonn: Proves that every coefficient of the generating function is nonnegative, via the explicit Dyck-path lattice counting model.
